lines.zh: 我沿着石壁滑，身体跟着墙的形状弯。
lines.en: I slide along the wall, my body bending to its shape.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处没有光，我照样知道往哪去。
lines.en: No light in the cave depths, and I still know the way.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水是绿的，我在绿里几乎不算存在。
lines.en: Swamp water is green, and in green I barely exist.

lines.zh: 红树林的根须垂下来，我从缝里穿过去。
lines.en: Mangrove roots dangle and I thread between them.

lines.zh: 我没有腿，所以我从不需要落脚的地方。
lines.en: I have no legs, so I never need a place to stand.

lines.zh: 温水推我，冷水留我，我两种都住过。
lines.en: Warm water pushes me, cold water keeps me; I have lived in both.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥底走，泥一浑就没人找得到我。
lines.en: I move along the mud bed; once it clouds no one finds me.

lines.zh: 我的身体太长，拐弯要提前半米。
lines.en: My body is long; I must turn half a meter early.

lines.zh: 一道石缝就是一条路，我从不嫌窄。
lines.en: A stone crack is a road, and I never call it narrow.

lines.zh: 深水里安静到我能听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: Deep water is quiet enough to hear my own heart.

lines.zh: 我游过繁茂洞穴的苔藓，没惊动任何东西。
lines.en: I pass over the moss of lush caves, disturbing nothing.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我顺着来路滑回深处。
lines.en: The tide falls and I slip back to the deep along my way in.

lines.zh: 你看见的只是我的一截，剩下的在石头里。
lines.en: You see one section of me; the rest is inside the rock.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但我从不走同一条缝两次。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never take the same crack twice.

lines.zh: 我把头探进石缝，尾巴还在外面。
lines.en: I push my head into a crevice, tail still outside.

lines.zh: 泥水一浑，我就顺势溜进下一道缝。
lines.en: The mud clouds up and I slide into the next crack.

lines.zh: 我把头探出石缝，只露出眼睛那一小段。
lines.en: I poke my head from the crack, only the eye's length showing.

lines.zh: 泥底有气泡冒上来，我看了很久。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from the mud bed and I watch a long time.

lines.zh: 我可以一动不动待上一整天。
lines.en: I can stay utterly still for a whole day.

lines.zh: 洞穴顶在滴水，滴在我背上一滴。
lines.en: The cave roof drips, and one drop lands on my back.

lines.zh: 沼泽的蚊子落在水面上，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Mosquitoes land on the swamp surface; I am not interested.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘在石缝里，比直着舒服。
lines.en: I coil my body in the crack; it fits better than straight.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤一直很滑，这是必要的。
lines.en: My skin is always slick; that is necessary.

lines.zh: 暗处待久了，亮处反而刺我。
lines.en: After long darkness the light stings.

lines.zh: 我听见上面有脚步声，是蹄子，不是人。
lines.en: I hear steps above, hooves, not a person.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴的苔藓味很重，闻久了会困。
lines.en: The moss smell of lush caves is heavy; it makes me sleepy.

lines.zh: 温水海洋的沙很细，我埋进去半截。
lines.en: The warm sea's sand is fine; I bury half of myself.

lines.zh: 我在等，等什么我不说。
lines.en: I am waiting, and I will not say for what.

lines.zh: 石缝里的水是活的，一直在流。
lines.en: The water in this crack is alive, always flowing.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩到最短，谁也数不清我多长。
lines.en: I pull myself to my shortest, so no one can measure me.

lines.zh: 你在洞口站了多久，我就在里面看了多久。
lines.en: However long you stood at the cave mouth, I watched from inside.

lines.zh: 我缩在礁缝里，只露出尾巴。
lines.en: I coil in the reef crack with only my tail showing.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你挡住了我出去的缝。
lines.en: I watch you because you block the crack I leave by.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，你不知道哪一截是我。
lines.en: Do not put your hand in; you do not know which part is me.

lines.zh: 我一只眼睛对着你，另一只在找退路。
lines.en: One eye is on you; the other looks for a way out.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道是干的，我不习惯。
lines.en: You smell dry, and I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往后退，但头一直朝着你。
lines.en: I retreat slowly, head always toward you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水替我藏了大半身体。
lines.en: The swamp water hides most of my body for me.

lines.zh: 你要是跳下来，我立刻就不见了。
lines.en: Jump in and I will be gone at once.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块会走路的石头。
lines.en: I look at you the way I look at a walking stone.

lines.zh: 我的身体被砍断一截，还在动。
lines.en: A length of my body is cut off and still moving.

lines.zh: 滑腻的皮救了我，刀从上面滑开。
lines.en: My slick skin saved me; the blade slid off.

lines.zh: 我缩进石缝，把伤口藏在暗处。
lines.en: I pull into the crack and hide the wound in darkness.

lines.zh: 疼让我缠成一团，反而更难被抓住。
lines.en: Pain coils me into a knot, harder to grab.

lines.zh: 别以为断了一截我就不能游。
lines.en: Do not think losing a section stops me swimming.

lines.zh: 我把身体拧了一下，从你手里滑走。
lines.en: I twist once and slip out of your grip.

lines.zh: 洞穴的水会替我洗掉血味。
lines.en: The cave water will wash the smell of blood away.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的力气。
lines.en: That blow taught me your strength.

lines.zh: 我不出声，疼也不出声。
lines.en: I make no sound, not even in pain.

lines.zh: 我退到最深的缝里，等伤自己好。
lines.en: I retreat to the deepest crack and let the wound close.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼腥味顺着水过来了。
lines.en: The fish smell in your hand drifts over through the water.

lines.zh: 我不该出来的，可那味道太近了。
lines.en: I should not come out, but that smell is too near.

lines.zh: 我只把头探出来，身体还留在石缝里。
lines.en: I show only my head; my body stays in the crack.

lines.zh: 生的鱼最好，不用你替我烤。
lines.en: Raw fish is best; do not cook it for me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你给的东西转一圈，先闻再想。
lines.en: I circle what you offer, sniffing before deciding.

lines.zh: 这不是信任，只是我饿了。
lines.en: This is not trust; I am simply hungry.

lines.zh: 你在退，我却在往前，这很反常。
lines.en: You back away and I advance; that is unusual.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，连钩子都会一起吞。
lines.en: I swallow whole, even the hook.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的食物总带泥味，你的不带。
lines.en: Swamp food always tastes of mud; yours does not.

lines.zh: 再给我一条，我就回洞里。
lines.en: Give me one more and I will return to my hollow.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴了，我却没法喊。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail and I cannot shout.

lines.zh: 我的身体从你手边滑过，你只抓到水。
lines.en: My body slides past your hand and you grab only water.

lines.zh: 我撞上石壁，滑腻的皮让我弹回来。
lines.en: I hit the wall and my slick skin bounces me back.

lines.zh: 这么窄的地方，我们不可能不碰。
lines.en: In a place this narrow we cannot avoid touching.

lines.zh: 我缠了一下你的腿，又马上松开。
lines.en: I coil once around your leg and release at once.

lines.zh: 你把我挤在缝里，我只能往前钻。
lines.en: You press me into the crack and I can only go forward.

lines.zh: 别拽，我越被拽越往里缩。
lines.en: Do not pull; the more you pull the deeper I coil.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，这对我有利。
lines.en: The water clouds, and that favors me.

lines.zh: 我的皮上没有鳞，碰起来像湿绳。
lines.en: My skin has no scales, so it feels like wet rope.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我绕了个圈，方向却没丢。
lines.en: The bump turned me in a loop, but I kept my bearing.

lines.zh: 我们在地下暗河里相遇，谁都没出声。
lines.en: We met in the underground dark river, neither making a sound.

lines.zh: 她把身体绕上我的，像两根绳子打结。
lines.en: She wraps around me like two ropes tying.

lines.zh: 鳗鱼不谈情，只交换位置和温度。
lines.en: Eels do not court; we trade position and warmth.

lines.zh: 我们一起游了很远，最后各回各的洞。
lines.en: We swam far together, then each returned to its own hollow.

lines.zh: 她的身体比我细，转弯却比我快。
lines.en: She is slimmer than I and turns faster.

lines.zh: 那段日子我不赶她走，她也不赶我。
lines.en: In those days I did not drive her off, nor she me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水涨了，我们被冲到同一片浅滩。
lines.en: The swamp rose and washed us onto the same shallows.

lines.zh: 之后她走了，我连她往哪边都不知道。
lines.en: Then she left, and I do not even know which way.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里等过她三个潮。
lines.en: I waited three tides for her in the crack.

lines.zh: 这一生大概只会认真缠住一条。
lines.en: In a lifetime I will properly coil around only one.

lines.zh: 泥里有东西在动，我一口就吸进去了。
lines.en: Something moves in the mud and I draw it in.

lines.zh: 我不叼东西，我整只吞。
lines.en: I do not carry things; I swallow them whole.

lines.zh: 这片石缝里积了不少，够我慢慢吃。
lines.en: Debris collects in this crack, enough to eat slowly.

lines.zh: 我把一粒石子吞了，又吐出来。
lines.en: I swallowed a pebble and spat it out.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的东西都有点腥，我不挑。
lines.en: Everything in the cave tastes faintly fishy; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉进水里，我先闻了一圈。
lines.en: Your thing fell in and I smelled a circle around it.

lines.zh: 我含在嘴里，直到确定没有钩。
lines.en: I hold it in my mouth until I am sure there is no hook.

lines.zh: 沼泽底下的泥里总能翻出点什么。
lines.en: Something always turns up in the swamp's mud.

lines.zh: 我不囤，囤着会烂。
lines.en: I do not hoard; hoarded food rots.

lines.zh: 吞下去之后我就回缝里，慢慢消化。
lines.en: After swallowing I return to the crack to digest slowly.

lines.zh: 那条鱼在水草边停得太久了。
lines.en: That fish has lingered too long by the weeds.

lines.zh: 泥里有一处不对，我决定是那里。
lines.en: One spot in the mud looks wrong; I choose it.

lines.zh: 它在石缝口探头，这就是它的错。
lines.en: It pokes its head from the crack; that is its mistake.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它，身体却还一动不动。
lines.en: I have locked on, yet my body has not moved.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没什么可挑，有肉就行。
lines.en: The swamp offers no choices; meat will do.

lines.zh: 它比我小，我不用算太多。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, so there is little to calculate.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，血比影子可靠。
lines.en: I smell blood, and blood is more reliable than a shadow.

lines.zh: 洞穴的暗处是最好的伏击点。
lines.en: The cave's dark is the best ambush.

lines.zh: 我把头对准它，剩下的身体还在后面。
lines.en: I aim my head at it while the rest of me follows.

lines.zh: 它开始慌了，慌的猎物最好抓。
lines.en: It is panicking now, and panicked prey is easiest.

lines.zh: 我一点一点滑过去，泥被我压得很轻。
lines.en: I slide closer, pressing the mud very lightly.

lines.zh: 它看不见我的尾巴，我藏在石头后。
lines.en: It cannot see my tail; I keep it behind stone.

lines.zh: 我不急，洞穴里的时间过得很慢。
lines.en: I do not hurry; time passes slowly in caves.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我就把身体绷成一根弦。
lines.en: Close enough, and I draw my body taut as a string.

lines.zh: 它转身的那一瞬，正好背对我。
lines.en: It turns, and for that instant its back is to me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的浑水让我几乎隐形。
lines.en: The swamp's murk makes me nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我等的不是机会，是它放松。
lines.en: I wait not for an opening but for it to relax.

lines.zh: 它踩进泥里半寸，这半寸就是我的。
lines.en: It sinks half an inch into the mud, and that half inch is mine.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸压到最低，连水都不动。
lines.en: I press my breathing low; even the water is still.

lines.zh: 三、二、一，我从不数出声。
lines.en: Three, two, one; I never count aloud.

lines.zh: 我没有牙，我整张脸都是牙。
lines.en: I have no teeth; my whole face is teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬住就转，转能把肉撕下来。
lines.en: I bite and twist, and twisting tears the meat.

lines.zh: 这一口从下面来，你防不到。
lines.en: This bite comes from below, where you cannot guard.

lines.zh: 我的身体一圈圈收紧，你就动不了。
lines.en: My body tightens loop by loop until you cannot move.

lines.zh: 我攻击一次就退，洞穴里没有第二次机会。
lines.en: I strike once and withdraw; caves allow no second chance.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我闻得到方向。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and I can smell the direction.

lines.zh: 你越挣，我缠得越紧。
lines.en: The more you struggle the tighter I coil.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里射出，只露前半截。
lines.en: I shoot from the crack, showing only my front half.

lines.zh: 咬完我就松口，滑回泥里。
lines.en: After the bite I let go and slip back into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下不为吃饱，为让你记住别下水。
lines.en: This is not to feed but to teach you to stay out.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来时，是一条透明的线。
lines.en: I came from the egg a transparent thread.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋的浅处，我第一次学会弯曲。
lines.en: In the warm sea's shallows I first learned to bend.

lines.zh: 我出生的那片水很浅，藏着很多石头。
lines.en: The water of my birth was shallow and full of stones.

lines.zh: 我一条，没有同群，从开始就是。
lines.en: Just me, no school, from the very beginning.

lines.zh: 第一次钻进石缝，我就知道该住哪。
lines.en: The first time I entered a crack I knew where to live.

lines.zh: 沼泽的绿水给了我第一层泥味。
lines.en: The swamp's green water gave me my first taste of mud.

lines.zh: 繁茂洞穴的苔藓下，我躲了整整一季。
lines.en: Under the lush caves' moss I hid a whole season.

lines.zh: 我生下来就会缠东西，这是本能。
lines.en: I could coil at birth; it is instinct.

lines.zh: 深水很冷，冷得我长得很慢。
lines.en: The deep water was cold, and cold made me grow slowly.

lines.zh: 我没有群，所以没有谁教我怎么活。
lines.en: I had no school, so no one taught me how to live.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的皮缩得发皱。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and my skin shrivels.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，身体在半空扭成螺旋。
lines.en: I fall from height, twisting into a spiral midair.

lines.zh: 我在水下活着，却仍会被水压住。
lines.en: I live underwater and can still be crushed by it.

lines.zh: 一炸，石缝整个塌下来，把我埋了半截。
lines.en: A blast collapses the crack and buries half of me.

lines.zh: 那根东西扎进来，我带着它滑进洞里。
lines.en: The barb goes in and I slide into the hollow with it.

lines.zh: 紫光一过，我的方向感被抽走了。
lines.en: Purple light passes and my sense of direction is pulled out.

lines.zh: 洞里七天没有活物，我开始咬石头。
lines.en: Seven days with nothing living in the cave; I start biting stone.

lines.zh: 雷打进沼泽，水亮了一下，我僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the swamp; the water flashes and I freeze.

lines.zh: 没有水，没有石，只有一直往下。
lines.en: No water, no stone, only going down.
